note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1939. There was no contest; nine of the fourteen divisions are named in the Ballymena Observer nomination report. Poll date Thursday 1 June 1939 (Ballymena Observer 2 Jun 1939 p. 5; BNL 4 May 1939 p. 13); filed under 1939-06-01, renamed from 1939-05-31 (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
